attack_plan.narrative: The siege at the Lindt cafe in Sydney has come to an end with a peaceful resolution, following intense negotiations between the police and the gunman. Reports indicate that three hostages have been successfully freed, with one escaping early in the morning and two more later in the day. The Grand Mufti of Australia issued a statement condemning the incident and calling for solidarity against extremism. In the aftermath, multiple eyewitnesses praised the calm and controlled manner in which the police handled the situation, ensuring the safety of the remaining hostages. As the situation unfolded, a Muslim woman removed her scarf out of fear after the siege and was comforted by strangers, highlighting the unity and support shown by the community. The siege lasted several hours, with the first hostage being freed in the early morning and the last two later in the day, ensuring their safety.
